label: Joined line
thesis: One more line in the lavender next-show band, in the card's plain link style, so the hub reads as part of the show-and-links strip at the top.
risk: Quiet: it looks like any other link and may be missed, and the band becomes a three-part stack on a phone.

label: Bordered block
thesis: A white, plum-bordered block under the strip with a headline-sized link and a note that it leaves the site, making the hub the clearest thing on the card after the next show.
risk: Loud: it can outweigh the next show and the act's facts, and a heavy box for what may be only a few links.

label: Corner tab
thesis: A small outlined chip at the right of the meta line, above the show strip, kept apart from the Links row without taking a row of its own.
risk: Sits above the next-show strip, not under it as the proposal says, and can wrap or crowd a long meta line on narrow screens.
